limitations: Geometry alone does not establish a legally qualifying highway or curb.
Stop, stand, park, traffic necessity and authority are independent review questions.
Physical pixels and legal applicability require independent original review.

necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

sweep_specs.rationale: Eight controlled original-source cases probe vehicle relation, activity and exception context without a legal numeric cutoff.
missing_inputs: No source-established finite numeric sweep bounds for either judgment phrase; retain qualitative controlled probes and original physical review.
